story.title: How We Met
story.paragraph1: It all started at a coffee shop in downtown Seattle. Sophie was reading "Pride and Prejudice" for the tenth time, and Alexander accidentally spilled his latte on her table.
story.paragraph2: Five years, three apartments, and countless cups of coffee later, we are ready to start our biggest adventure yet. We cannot wait to celebrate our love with our favorite people in the world.
story.quote: "Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same."
